gap_fill_decisions: outcome horizon 60 min (member of the registry set) and 15m signal timeframe (derived from the 1m base)
'established move' = 4 completed 15m bars (1h) of net displacement >= 1.5 ATR; 1.5 chosen as the same multiple used by FRONT-1's frozen stop policy, not tuned
last-bar confirmation added so the signal is not taken on a bar that already reverses the move
missing_in_source: position-sizing rule (supplied by the EUR 500 capital model of this task)
single outcome horizon (registry lists candidate sets only)
cost model (supplied by the shared harness)
name: FAST -- Intraday Trend Continuation

operationalization.entry: market at next-open after bar completion
exits: time exit at the first 15m boundary >= signal bar close + 60 min
operationalization.rule: LONG if z_move_4 >= +1.5 AND the last completed 15m bar closed up; SHORT mirror. z_move_4 = (C_t - C_{t-4}) / (ATR14(15m) * sqrt(4)) (A3).

source_registry.constraint: must NOT reuse R05's methodology or parameters
source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: an established short-horizon directional move continues over the near-term outcome horizon (momentum persistence at intraday scale). No formula frozen.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars (recommended base frequency), derived 5m/15m/30m/1h.
